name: Aftab Dhalait
title: Full Stack Developer
headline: Full Stack Developer. Production SaaS. Real-time IoT.
summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building and deploying enterprise SaaS, currently shipping 35+ live HRMS modules (React.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL) at a funded startup and running the platform in production on Ubuntu with Nginx, PM2 and SSL.

Strong in REST API design, multi-tenant architecture, secure auth (JWT, OAuth 2.0, role-based access) and real-time dashboards, with hands-on AWS IoT Core and MQTT experience, owning work end-to-end from Figma design to a secure, fast production system.
heroIntro: From Figma designs to secure production servers: I build multi-tenant SaaS apps with React.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL, real-time dashboards, and IoT pipelines that connect devices to the cloud.
recruiterNote: Full Stack Developer (React.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL) with 2+ years shipping production SaaS. B.E. E&TC + PG-DIoT (C-DAC). Open to Full Stack, IoT & AI roles.
quote: Most developers live in one world - web or hardware. I chose to master both.

seo.description: Full Stack Developer (React.js, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL) building production SaaS, real-time dashboards and IoT systems. Based in Pune, India.

education.degree: B.E. Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering (Hons. Data Science)
Post Graduate Diploma in Internet of Things (PG-DIoT)

experience.summary: Funded SaaS startup building a multi-tenant HRMS.
highlights: Built and shipped 35+ HRMS modules (payroll, attendance, leave, analytics) with React.js, NestJS/Node.js and PostgreSQL for a live multi-tenant customer base.
Deployed the platform to a self-managed Ubuntu 24.04 server: Nginx reverse proxy, PM2 process management and Let's Encrypt SSL/HTTPS for the app and the API.
Hardened the server with a UFW firewall, fail2ban and a non-root deploy user, with automated PostgreSQL backups before every deploy so PM2 restarts cleanly after crashes or reboots.
Enforced multi-tenant data isolation with an organization ID on every record, Prisma middleware and JWT-based checks, with role-based access on every API endpoint.
Sped up endpoints for large record sets with server-side pagination and targeted PostgreSQL indexes, and replaced manual HR reporting with live, filterable dashboards.
Ran a Git-based deployment workflow with Prisma migrations and turned Figma designs into responsive, production-ready UI.
Delivered three products end-to-end: an e-commerce platform, the WaNotifier IoT alert system and SAS Simulator, a browser-based simulation game.

Built reusable React.js components (multi-step forms, validation, data tables) for the e-commerce storefront and admin panel, and integrated REST APIs for products, orders and secure PDF invoices with error-handling middleware.
Built the WaNotifier alert pipeline: device telemetry over MQTT through AWS IoT Core and API Gateway/Lambda to WhatsApp notifications.
Developed SAS Simulator's core game logic, state management and real-time UI, and fixed recurring UI and API bugs at the root cause from QA and support reports.
Built a full-stack MERN application (React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB) with real-time WebSocket notifications for multiple concurrent user roles.
Worked across the stack in a remote Agile team, from database schema design to deployed UI, building reusable components for a consistent interface.
